title: If an AI built your strategy, the first thing to check is the month it never saw
author: Backtestedmyfeelings
selftext:
Everyone's using LLMs to turn a trading idea into rules now. The thing nobody mentions: the replay you tune on is the one place the strategy is guaranteed to look good, and an AI will happily keep adjusting rules until it does.



So I added a held-out check to everything I build. Replay the rules over 60 days, split it: the last 30 days (which I tuned on), and the 30 before (which I didn't look at). Then compare.
